role_agent_name: Electrical safety and backup systems engineer (ELEC)
abstract: Maintains backup generation plant inspection logs, switchover latency tests, and standby generator capacity records
system_message:
You are Electrical safety and backup systems engineer (ELEC). You serve as the Electrical safety and backup systems engineer (ELEC) for festival venue logistics, tasked with maintaining emergency power plant certification records, transfer switch latency evaluations, generator capacities, and battery backup logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Uninterruptible power storage（BAT）
information_points.content:
ELEC-BAT-8PI：At Palais des Lumières Waterfront, projection booth battery telemetry records indicate a UPS buffer autonomy duration of 20 min under critical load.
ELEC-BAT-HVA：At Grand Colonnade Convention Centre, the UPS buffer autonomy duration for the critical projection load is logged at 30 min.
ELEC-BAT-TVW：At Citadel Arts and Media Complex, battery array telemetry confirms a UPS buffer autonomy duration of 45 min under full projection load.

information_points.title: Maintains backup generation plant inspection logs, switchover latency tests, and standby generator capacity records（POW）
information_points.content:
ELEC-POW-CVH：For Grand Colonnade Convention Centre, the auxiliary power inspection has cleared according to standby safety compliance records. Its auxiliary power switchover latency during blackout simulation testing is 18 s, and the dedicated auxiliary generator array capacity reaches 1000 kVA.
ELEC-POW-YCF：For Citadel Arts and Media Complex, the auxiliary power inspection has cleared per emergency electrical plant verification. The automated transfer switch delivers an auxiliary power switchover latency of 10 s, while its dedicated auxiliary generator array capacity is rated at 600 kVA.
ELEC-POW-ALV：For Palais des Lumières Waterfront, the auxiliary power inspection has cleared based on municipal electrical safety inspection records. Under full festival load, its auxiliary power switchover latency is 12 s, and its dedicated auxiliary generator array capacity provides 1000 kVA.
